controller_6m.notes: Adversarially verified. Quote on p289 matches the prospectus verbatim (one trivial paren-rendering difference at 'Banking Ordinance (Chapter 155 of the Laws of Hong Kong)...': the p289 PDF text has '(Hong Kong) for a bona fide commercial loan)' while the candidate quote uses the p290-style rendering '(Hong Kong)) for a bona fide commercial loan)'; the prospectus is internally inconsistent between pp.289-290 — non-substantive, no correction needed). Holder is correctly flagged NON-STANDARD: p214 confirms Mr. Wang (chairman, executive Director, co-general manager), Mr. Zhou (executive Director, general manager), Mr. Liu Yi (劉屹), Camsense Investment, Xinle Management and Camsense Era hold ~31.20% pre-offering / ~27.45% post-offering via concert party and 'will not be regarded as our controlling shareholders under the Listing Rules, but will remain as the single largest group of Shareholders'. The Rule 10.07 undertaking is given by this Single Largest Group of Shareholders. Date math recomputed: endpoint 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' is anniversary-INCLUSIVE per repository convention, so last restricted day = 2027-03-30 and first free day = 2027-03-31. The one-day difference vs the cornerstone block (2027-03-30) is justified by the different wording ('from (and inclusive of)' → anniversary exclusive vs 'ending on the date which is six months from' → anniversary inclusive). Notes on the parallel underwriter undertaking are accurate: p291 confirms the Single Largest Group undertook to the underwriters covering the 'First Six Month Period' with the authorized-institution pledge/charge carve-out, plus a parallel 6-month pledge-notification undertaking.

controller_12m.notes: Absence correctly established. p214 confirms no controlling shareholders exist, so no Rule 10.07(3)-type 12-month control undertaking is possible. The only 12-month undertaking by the Single Largest Group of Shareholders (pp.289-290) is verified to be confined to pledge/charge NOTIFICATION duties under Note (2) to Rule 10.07(2) — informing the Company in writing of pledges/charges to authorized institutions and of pledgee/chargee indications of disposal — not a control or disposal restriction. The First/Second Six-Month Period undertakings (pp.290-291) bind the COMPANY only (new issues) for the First Six-Month Period, and the Second Six-Month Period undertaking is likewise a Company-side obligation. The PRC statutory 12-month ban is verified verbatim at p124 ('Pursuant to the applicable PRC laws and regulations, within the 12 months following the Listing Date, no existing Shareholders (including the Pre-IPO Investors) may dispose of any of the Shares held by them.') and correctly treated as a statutory lock-up on all pre-Listing shareholders rather than a controller control undertaking. Minor note-only correction: the candidate's notes cite 'also page 16' for the PRC ban, but a full-document search for the 12-month lock-up finds it only at p124 (no such text on p16); this affects an informal citation in notes only, not any structured field.
